questions.question: What is a wig wag?

options.text: A tube that moves air from the compressor to the tanks
A noise made by air brakes when they are used
A part in the braking unit that lets air move freely

questions.explanation: A wig wag is a low air pressure warning device in an air brake system. It drops a mechanical arm into your view when air pressure drops below 60 psi.

questions.question: If an aggressive driver confronts you, you should:

options.text: Make eye contact to communicate better with them
Not move out of their way

questions.explanation: If an aggressive driver confronts you, get out of their way if possible. Do not make eye contact, as this could provoke them. Do not let them anger you with their actions.

questions.question: During an emergency stop using controlled braking, you should:

options.text: Press the brakes as hard as you can without locking the wheels
Apply the brakes with about half your normal force
Apply the brakes so the wheels lock
Apply the brakes with very light pressure

questions.correctAnswerText: Press the brakes as hard as you can without locking the wheels
questions.explanation: For controlled braking in an emergency, press the brakes as hard as possible without locking the wheels. Keep steering wheel movements small when using this method.

questions.question: What can happen if the exhaust system is not working properly?

options.text: Poisonous fumes may enter the cab
Poisonous fumes may exit the rear of the muffler system
It may cause problems if the trailer is fully loaded

questions.correctAnswerText: Poisonous fumes may enter the cab
questions.explanation: A broken exhaust system can let poisonous fumes enter your cab or sleeper berth. Check your exhaust system regularly for damage.

questions.question: One job of the emergency air line is to:

options.text: Flash when air pressure drops below a certain level

questions.explanation: The emergency air line (also called the supply line) has two jobs. It supplies air to the trailer air tanks and controls the emergency brakes on combination vehicles.

questions.question: ____ cause more than half of all accident-related truck driver deaths.
questions.explanation: Truck rollovers cause more than half of all accident-related truck driver deaths. To prevent rollover accidents, load cargo low and centered on your truck. Take corners slowly.

questions.question: When driving long distances, you should:
questions.explanation: To avoid fatigue on long trips, take a break every 100 miles or every two hours. Driving at night or when you normally sleep increases the risk of fatigue.

questions.question: What color light shows that a vehicle's ABS is not working?
questions.explanation: On vehicles with Anti-Lock Braking Systems (ABS), a yellow warning light alerts you to an ABS problem.

questions.question: While driving, you should:

options.text: Plan how to handle any dangerous situation that might happen
Focus only on your own driving and ignore other drivers

questions.correctAnswerText: Plan how to handle any dangerous situation that might happen
questions.explanation: While driving, constantly check the road ahead for hazards. Have a plan ready for any danger that might occur.

questions.question: If an aggressive driver confronts you, you should:

options.text: Make eye contact with the driver

questions.explanation: If an aggressive driver confronts you, get out of their way. Do not make eye contact, do not speed up to challenge them, and do not respond to angry gestures.

questions.question: Reaching for a phone unsafely while driving is:

options.text: Okay if you are driving alone.
Okay if you plan to use hands-free mode.
Not okay, even if you plan to use hands-free mode.

questions.correctAnswerText: Not okay, even if you plan to use hands-free mode.
questions.explanation: Your phone must be within reach while you sit safely in your seat. Reaching unsafely for your phone while driving is dangerous and illegal, even if you plan to use hands-free mode.

questions.question: When you leave your vehicle parked:

options.text: Use the parking brake only on hills.
Do not use the parking brake because it damages tires.

questions.explanation: Always use the parking brake when you park. However, do not use it if your brakes are very hot or if they are wet and it is freezing outside.

questions.question: A converter gear is:

options.text: A lock on a trailer door.
A trailer at the end of a combination.
Not needed on doubles or triples.

questions.explanation: A converter gear is a coupling device on a dolly. It has one or two axles and a fifth wheel. You attach a semi-trailer to it on the back of a tractor-trailer combination.

questions.question: Eating while driving is:

options.text: A good way to save time.
Okay if the food is easy to eat.

questions.explanation: Eating, drinking, and smoking distract you from driving. Plan ahead and stop to eat on long trips instead of eating while driving.

questions.question: When coupling a double or triple, which trailer do you attach last?

options.text: The trailer right behind the cab

questions.explanation: Attach the rearmost trailer last when coupling a double or triple combination.

questions.question: When making tight maneuvers, a driver should:

options.text: Open the door for a better view.

questions.explanation: Check your mirrors often while driving. This is especially important when changing lanes, turning, merging, or making tight maneuvers.

questions.question: When driving long distances, you should stop for a break ____ to prevent fatigue.
questions.explanation: Stop for a break at least once every two hours or every 100 miles to avoid becoming too tired while driving.

questions.question: When an air supply control is in the "emergency" position, it will:
questions.explanation: Older vehicles may use levers instead of knobs for tractor protection controls. When the air supply control is set to "emergency," the air supply stops and the trailer emergency brakes activate.

questions.question: During the pre-trip inspection, when you start the vehicle, the coolant temperature should:
questions.explanation: After starting your vehicle, watch the temperature gauge. The coolant temperature should gradually rise to the normal operating range.

questions.question: Hydraulic brakes can fail because of:
questions.explanation: Hydraulic brakes usually fail because of lost hydraulic pressure. They can also fail from overuse on long downgrades.
